plain_language_definition: CA1 pyramidal neuron fraction
Reactive Astrocyte / (Astrocyte + Reactive Astrocyte) within CA1
CA1 proportion of pyramidal neurons with at least one reactive astrocyte within 80 full-resolution pixels (~40 µm).
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with >=1 CA1 reactive astrocyte within 60 px.
Round failed or timed out; no evaluable biomarker was preserved for this discarded round.
Median log1p(contour area px^2) of CA1 pyramidal neurons within 80 px of any CA1 reactive astrocyte centroid.
80 px reactive-astrocyte radius; small pyramidal neurons defined below donor CA1 pyramidal area 33rd percentile.
Fraction/enrichment of small CA1 pyramidal neurons near reactive astrocytes within 80 pixels, with small cells defined by the donor-level lower 20th percentile.
20th percentile of log1p(area) for CA1 pyramidal neurons within 80 px of any CA1 reactive astrocyte.
EC reactive-astrocyte-proximal pyramidal lower-tail area with 80 px radius.
CA1 Pyramidal Neuron count divided by all classified CA1 cells.
CA1 Reactive Astrocyte / (Reactive Astrocyte + Astrocyte)
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons whose local astroglial neighbors within 70 pixels are enriched for reactive astrocytes.
Baseline CA1 reactive astrocyte hypertrophy contrast: median(log1p(area_px2)) of CA1 Reactive Astrocytes minus median(log1p(area_px2)) of CA1 Astrocytes.
Reactive astrocyte microcluster fraction minus non-reactive astrocyte microcluster fraction, where a microcluster requires at least 3 same-class neighbors within 70 pixels.
CA1 pyramidal fraction exposed to reactive-astrocyte hotspots minus CA1 pyramidal fraction exposed to baseline astrocyte hotspots; hotspot = at least 3 same-label neighbors within 70 px.
Same hotspot definition, but pyramidal neighbors counted within 50 px to focus on immediate pericellular depletion.
Same biomarker but with a slightly stricter hotspot threshold k=4 same-type neighbors within 70 px.
Reactive-astrocyte hotspot local Corpora Amylacea fraction minus astrocyte hotspot local Corpora Amylacea fraction in CA1, r=70 px, k=3.

Mean local lymphocyte fraction within 70 px around CA1 reactive-astrocyte hotspots minus the same fraction around matched CA1 astrocyte hotspots; hotspot rule uses >=3 same-class neighbors within 70 px.
Reactive Astrocyte / (Astrocyte + Reactive Astrocyte) among CA1-assigned cells.
Fraction or index of CA1 pyramidal-neuron neighborhoods within 35 um that contain reactive astrocytes.
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 1 reactive astrocyte within 35 um.
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 2 CA1 reactive astrocytes within 35 µm
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 2 nearby astrocyte-lineage cells within 35 um where most nearby astrocyte-lineage cells are reactive.
Median contour area of CA1 reactive astrocytes within 35 µm of any CA1 pyramidal neuron
Mean per-CA1-pyramidal-neuron summed reactive-astrocyte contour area within 35 µm
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with >=2 Reactive Astrocytes and >=1 Lymphocyte within 50 um.
Among CA1 pyramidal neurons with a severe reactive cuff (>=2 reactive astrocytes within 50 um), fraction that also have >=1 nearby lymphocyte within 50 um.
Among CA1 pyramidal neurons with a severe reactive cuff (>=2 reactive astrocytes within 50 um), fraction that also have >=2 nearby lymphocytes within 50 um.
Fraction of classified CA1 cells that are pyramidal neurons.
CA1 Reactive Astrocyte / (CA1 Reactive Astrocyte + CA1 Astrocyte)
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with nearby reactive astrocytes using the selected local-neighbor radius.
median(log contour area) of CA1 Reactive Astrocytes minus median(log contour area) of CA1 Astrocytes
Fraction of local CA1 neighborhoods within 60 um where astrocyte-lineage cells are predominantly reactive.
Fraction/extent of CA1 reactive-astrocyte neighborhoods with low local pyramidal-neuron presence using the selected t20 threshold.
Log-area shift of CA1 pyramidal neurons located within 60 pixels, about 30 um, of reactive astrocytes.
Fraction/extent of CA1 reactive-neighborhood pyramidal neurons with no or reduced oligodendrocyte neighbors within 80 pixels, about 40 um.
Fraction of CA1 reactive-niche pyramidal neurons with at least one Corpora Amylacea within 96 px.
Fraction of CA1 reactive-neighborhood cells or pyramidal-neuron niches with at least one nearby lymphocyte within 128 pixels.
Reactive Astrocyte / (Astrocyte + Reactive Astrocyte) within CA1
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least one CA1 reactive astrocyte within ~30 um.
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with at least 3 CA1 reactive astrocytes within 30 um.
Median area of CA1 reactive astrocytes whose centroids are within 30 microns of any CA1 pyramidal neuron.
CA1 peripyramidal astrocyte-lineage reactivity index using a 30 um radius around CA1 pyramidal neurons.
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons in reactive-astrocyte neighborhoods with a sparse or isolated configuration based on up to 5 nearby cells within 30 um.
More local version: fraction of CA1 peripyramidal reactive astrocytes with at least one CA1 lymphocyte within 20 um.
Fraction of CA1 pyramidal neurons with both nearby reactive astrocytes and nearby lymphocytes within 25 um.
Fraction of CA1 reactive-astro-exposed pyramidal neurons with at least 1 lymphocyte within 25 um.

Peripyramidal reactive astrocytes within 30 um of CA1 pyramidal neurons; score is summed area of lymphocyte-contacting cells / peripyramidal reactive astrocyte count, with lymphocyte contact defined within 20 um.
